description:
Jinyun Maofeng is a green tea listed among the regional teas of Chongqing. Beyond that listing very little is recorded, so treat this as a sketch.

The word maofeng points to a type: tender shoots with visible down, usually finished by baking. If it follows the type, you would expect a slender leaf and a light, fresh cup, though no specific account confirms this for this tea.

Brew it as any tender green, with water off the boil and a short first steep. Taste and adjust instead of relying on a recipe.

One caution: the name Jinyun also belongs to a county in Zhejiang, while Chongqing has its own Jinyun Mountain, so ask the seller where the tea was actually grown.
